query:
SELECT mc.characterName, mc.imageUrl, mc.cardNumber, ms.name
FROM marvel_cards mc 
JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id 
WHERE mc.characterName IN ('Loki', 'Mr. Fantastic', 'Captain Marvel', 'Mighty Thor')
AND mc.cardType = 'Base'
ORDER BY mc.characterName;
